questionText: During which stage of the fundamental test process is the testability of requirements evaluated?
options: Test Design.
Test Analysis.
Test Execution.
Test Planning.
correctAnswer: Test Analysis.
explanation: Refer 1.4.1 đánh giá khả năng test của requirement là của Analysis

questionText: Which of the following BEST describes a Test Case?
options: A testable aspect of a component or system identified as a basis for testing.
A description of the test objectives to be achieved and the means and the schedule for achieving them.
A set of preconditions, inputs, actions, expected results and postconditions developed based on test conditions.
A source to determine expected results to compare with the actual result of the system under test.
correctAnswer: A set of preconditions, inputs, actions, expected results and postconditions developed based on test conditions.
explanation: Glossary tra test case ra đáp án C. A là của test condition, B là test plan, D là test oracle

questionText: During the development of a software change for a system, the developer makes a mistake in his work, which leads to a fault in the code. Unfortunately, the fault is not found by software testing and is released into live. What is the DEFINITE consequence of this mistake?
options: If the defect is executed, the system may fail.
Loss of money, time, or business reputation.
The system will fail, causing a defect.
Contractual requirements have not been met by testing.
correctAnswer: If the defect is executed, the system may fail.
explanation: Refer 1.2.3 Hậu quả cuối cùng của Mistake là gì? ta hiểu là Failure. Nhưng A đúng vì có may fail. B sai ko liên quan đến tiền, C sai vì will fail là chắc chắn sẽ fail ( hiểu là không phải tất cả các defect đều làm cho hệ thống fail, ví dụ như lỗi sai conding convention). D sai vì ko liên quan đến contract

questionText:
Which of the following are benefits of an independent test team, and which are drawbacks?
a) Independent testers can find different defects.
b) Developers may put less emphasis on quality.
c) Independent testers can be seen as the reason for delayed projects.
d) Independent testers can verify assumptions made during the specification of a system
options: a and b are benefits, c and d are drawbacks.
b and c are benefits, a and d are drawbacks.
a and d are benefits, b and c are drawbacks.
c and d are benefits, a and b are drawbacks.
correctAnswer: a and d are benefits, b and c are drawbacks.
explanation: Refer 1.5.3

questionText: What is quality assurances?
options: The total costs incurred on quality activities and issues and often split into prevention costs, appraisal costs...
The degree to which a component or system protects information and data...
Part of quality management focused on providing confidence that quality requirements will be fulfilled.
The degree to which a component, system or process meets specified requirements...
correctAnswer: Part of quality management focused on providing confidence that quality requirements will be fulfilled.
explanation: Refer 1.2.2 và Glossary tra quality assurance ra C là đúng, A sai vì là cost of quality, B sai vì protects information and data là của security, D sai là định nghĩa của quality

questionText: Which of the following provides the BEST description of a test ware?
options: A document specifying a sequence of actions for the execution of a test.
A set of input values and expected results
An attribute of a system specified by requirements documentation
Work products produced during the test process for use in planning, designing, executing, evaluating and reporting on testing
correctAnswer: Work products produced during the test process for use in planning, designing, executing, evaluating and reporting on testing
explanation: Refer 1.4.3 và Glossary để tra từ. D là đúng, A là của test scripts, B là test case, C là non-functional

questionText: The testing approach with the least independence is:
options: Having another developer on the same team write the tests
Having a tester on an independent team write the tests
Having the users write the tests
Having the developer write tests for his own code
correctAnswer: Having the developer write tests for his own code
explanation: refer 1.5.3 Mức độc lập thấp nhất là D

questionText: Which option is part of the implementation and execution area of the fundamental test process?
options: Developing the tests.
Comparing actual and expected results
Writing a test summary.
Analysing lessons learnt for future releases.
correctAnswer: Comparing actual and expected results
explanation: Refer 1.4 tìm ra B. A là của Design, C là của Monitoring, D là của Completion test

questionText: Which statement is most true?
options: Different testing is needed depending upon the application.
All software is tested in the same way.
A technique that finds defects will always find defects.
A technique that has found no defects is not useful.
correctAnswer: Different testing is needed depending upon the application.
explanation: Refer 1.3 nói về 7 nguyên lý test thì A là nguyên lý 6 Test phụ thuộc vào ngữ cảnh và phần mềm khác nhau. B sai All, C sai kỹ thuật tìm ra lỗi luôn luôn ( always) tìm ra lỗi là sai, D sai "kỹ thuật không tìm ra lỗi là không hữu ích"

questionText: A bug or defect is:?
options: A mistake made by a person;
A run-time problem experienced by a user;
The result of an error or mistake;
The result of a failure, which may lead to an error?
correctAnswer: The result of an error or mistake;
explanation: Refer 1.2.3 sơ đồ Error- Defect- Failure thì tìm ra là C. Defect là kết quả của 1 error

questionText: Which of the following is correct? Debugging is:
options: Testing/checking whether the software performs correctly.
Checking that a previously reported defect has been corrected.
Identifying the cause of a defect, repairing the code and checking the fix is correct.
Checking that no unintended consequences have occurred as a result of a fix.
correctAnswer: Identifying the cause of a defect, repairing the code and checking the fix is correct.
explanation: Refer 1.1.2 Debugging. D sai vì là định nghĩa của regression test, A là hoạt động test, B là retest

questionText: Which list of levels of tester independence is in the correct order, starting with the most independent first?
options: Tests designed by the author; tests designed by another member...
Tests designed by someone from a different department...; tests designed by the author...
Tests designed by someone from a different company; tests designed by someone from a different department...; tests designed by another member...
Tests designed by someone from a different department...; tests designed by someone from a different company...
correctAnswer: Tests designed by someone from a different company; tests designed by someone from a different department...; tests designed by another member...
explanation: Refer 1.5.3 thứ tự của test independence đúng tứ mức độc lập cao nhất trở xuống, C là đúng nhất

questionText: Which of the following defines the expected result of a test?
options: Test case
Test procedure
Test execution schedule
Test condition
correctAnswer: Test case
explanation: Glossary tra cứu định nghĩa Test case, có chứa thông tin về expected result của 1 cái test

questionText: When assembling a test team to work on an enhancement to an existing system, which of the following has the highest level of test independence?
options: A business analyst who wrote the original requirements for the system.
A permanent programmer who reviewed some of the new code, but has not written any of it.
A permanent tester who found most defects in the original system.
A contract tester who has never worked for the organization before.
correctAnswer: A contract tester who has never worked for the organization before.
explanation: Refer1.5.3 các mức độ độc lập thì D là cao nhất vì contract tester là thuê ngoài về

questionText:
The following statements relate to activities that are part of the fundamental test process.
i. Evaluating the testability of requirements.
ii. Repeating testing activities after changes.
iii. Designing the test environment set-up.
iv. Developing and prioritizing test cases.
v. Verifying the environment is set up correctly.
Which statement below is TRUE?
options: (i) and (ii) are part of analysis and design...
(i) and (iii) , (iv) are part of analysis and design...
(i) and (v) are part of analysis and design...
(i) and (iv) are part of analysis and design, (ii), (iii) and (v) are part of test implementation and execution.
correctAnswer: (i) and (iii) , (iv) are part of analysis and design...
explanation: Refer 1.4.1

questionText: Which statement correctly describes the public and profession aspects of the code of ethics?
options: Public: Certified software testers shall act in the best interests of their client... Profession...
Public: Certified software testers shall advance the integrity and reputation... Profession...
Public: Certified software testers shall consider the wider public interest... Profession: Certified software testers shall participate...

Public: Certified software testers shall consider the wider public interest in their actions. Profession: Certified software testers shall advance the integrity and reputation of their industry consistent with the public interest.
correctAnswer: Public: Certified software testers shall consider the wider public interest in their actions. Profession: Certified software testers shall advance the integrity and reputation of their industry consistent with the public interest.
explanation: Theo 1 tài liệu trên mạng chúng tôi đọc đc thì "the code of ethics" được coi là 1 "set of rules or regulary about good and bad behavior" cần phải được tuân thủ theo khi phát triển và test phần mềm ( confidential information là 1 ví dụ rất rõ về cái này)  , các rules này xuất phát từ nhiều nguồn khác nhau: The benefit and interest of public (consider act in the interest of public là xem xét đến các mối quan tâm của cộng đồng), Professional ( tester should follow the set of values, principles, standards and advance the integrity of their profession tester nên tuân theo các rules, standards, principles mà team đưa ra để đảm bảo tính toàn vẹn và chuyên nghiệp)

questionText:
Which of the following are valid justifications for developers testing their own code during unit testing?
(i) Their lack of independence is mitigated by independent testing during system and acceptance testing.
(ii) A person with a good understanding of the code can find more defects more quickly using white-box techniques.
(iii) Developers have a better understanding of the requirements than testers.
(iv) Testers write unnecessary incident reports because they find minor differences between the way in which the system behaves and the way in which it is specified to work.
options: (i) and (ii)
(i) and (iv)
(ii) and (iii)
(iii) and (iv)
correctAnswer: (i) and (ii)
explanation: Refer 1.5.3 câu hỏi là giải thích về việc developer thực hiện unit test trên code của anh ta thì là i đúng vì thiếu độc lập ( khách quan) nên cần phải có tester độc lập test ở phase sau, ii đúng vì developer hiểu biết về code, tìm lỗi và sửa lỗi nhanh hơn. iii sai vì developer không thể hiểu requirement hơn tester độc lập, iv sai vì "unnecessary incident reports"

questionText: Which one of the following describes the major benefit of verification early in the life cycle?
options: It allows the identification of changes in user requirements.
It facilitates timely set up of the test environment.
It reduces defect multiplication.
It allows testers to become involved early in the project.
correctAnswer: It reduces defect multiplication.
explanation: Refer 1.1.1 và 1.2.3 chú ý vào từ "verification early" tìm sớm lỗi sẽ ko phát sinh nhiều vào trong các tài liệu khác

questionText: Even though a test that once revealed many defects is part of the regression suite, no new test cases have been created for the module under test in a long time. What test principle is the test team forgetting?
options: Absence-of-errors fallacy
Defect clustering
Tests wear out
Early testing
correctAnswer: Tests wear out
explanation: refer 1.3. chú ý "no new test cases have been created"

questionText: Test objectives vary between projects and so must be stated in the test plan. Which one of the following test objectives might conflict with the proper tester mindset?
options: Show that the system works before we ship it.
Find as many defects as possible
Reduce the overall level of product risk
Prevent defects through early involvement
correctAnswer: Show that the system works before we ship it.
explanation: Refer 1.3 Test ko chứng minh được hệ thống làm việc hay không vì thế mà "test objectives" và test mindset có thể bị mâu thuẫn với nhau

questionText: Which of the following characterises the cost of faults?
options: They are cheapest to find in the early development phases and the most expensive to fix in the latest test phases.
They are easiest to find during system testing but the most expensive to fix then.
Faults are cheapest to find in the early development phases but the most expensive to fix then.
Although faults are most expensive to find during early development phases, they are cheapest to fix then.
correctAnswer: They are cheapest to find in the early development phases and the most expensive to fix in the latest test phases.
explanation: Refer 1.1.1 đặc điểm của chi phí về lỗi?

questionText: Which activity in the Fundamental Test Process creates test suites for efficient test execution?
options: Implementation and execution
Analysis and design
Planning and control
Test closure
correctAnswer: Implementation and execution
explanation: refer 1.4.1 chú ý "creates test suites"

questionText:
The list below (a to e) describes one major task for each of the five main activities of the fundamental test process. Which option (A to D) places the tasks in the correct order, by time?
a) Create bi-directional traceability between test basis and test cases.
b) Check test logs against exit criteria.
c) Define the objectives of testing.
d) Check planned deliverables have been delivered.
e) Comparing actual results with expected results.
options: a, c, b, e, d
c, a, d, e, b
c, a, e, b, d
d, a, c, b, e
correctAnswer: c, a, e, b, d
explanation: Refer 1.4.1 Thứ tự nào diễn ra là đúng? chọn c là task của test plan, a là của test design, e là test execution, b là evaluate exit criteria trong giai đoạn chạy test, d là của test completion

questionText:
Which of the following are DEBUGGING activities?
a) Designing tests to find failures.
b) Locating the cause of failures.
c) Analysing and fixing the defects.
d) Executing tests to show failures.
options: a and d.
a and b.
b and c.
c and d.
correctAnswer: b and c.
explanation: refer 1.1.2 Kiểm tra và gỡ lỗi là các hoạt động chính trong vòng đời phát triển phần mềm. Hoạt động nào sau đây là hoạt động DEBUGGING? chọn b c

questionText:
Which of the following are TESTING activities?
a) Designing tests to find failures.
b) Locating the cause of failures.
c) Analysing and fixing the defects.
d) Executing tests to show failures.
options: a and d
a and b.
b and c.
c and d.
correctAnswer: a and d
explanation: refer 1.1.2 Kiểm tra và gỡ lỗi là các hoạt động chính trong vòng đời phát triển phần mềm. Hoạt động nào sau đây là hoạt động THỬ NGHIỆM? chọn a, d là của testing

questionText: Which of the following options BEST explains the "Tests wear out" principle of testing?
options: If we do not regularly review and revise our tests, we'll stop finding defects.
Repeatedly running a set of tests will ensure that a system is defect free.
Defects are, paradoxically, often contained in a small number of modules.
Testing, like spraying pesticide, is an effective bug/defect removal activity
correctAnswer: If we do not regularly review and revise our tests, we'll stop finding defects.
explanation: refer 1.3 (Pesticide Paradox) If we do not regularly review and revise our tests, we’ll stop finding defects.

questionText: What does the term “Tests wear out” refer to?
options: The phenomena where a piece of code that has a lot of bugs is likely to have more hidden, yet unfound bugs
The decreasing efficiency of debugging when done in code that has many bugs
Reduced effectiveness of test cases that are repeated and focused on the same scenarios
The redundancy of testing the same objects in both black and white box techniques
correctAnswer: Reduced effectiveness of test cases that are repeated and focused on the same scenarios
explanation: refer 1.3 Thuật ngữ “Thử nghiệm hao mòn” ám chỉ điều gì? chú ý chọn C vì 'Repeated and focused on the same scenarios'

questionText: In foundation level syllabus you will find the main basic principles of testing. Which of the following sentences describes one of these basic principles?
options: Complete testing of software is attainable if you have enough resources and test tools
For a software system, it is not possible, under normal conditions, to test all input and output combinations
A goal of testing is to show that the software is defect free
With automated testing you can make statements with more confidence about the quality of a product than with manual testing
correctAnswer: For a software system, it is not possible, under normal conditions, to test all input and output combinations
explanation: refer 1.3 Câu nào sau đây mô tả một trong những nguyên tắc cơ bản này? chú ý vào 'it is not possible' chọn B

questionText: Which of the following is NOT a valid objective of testing?
options: Ensuring required coverage of a test object
Investigating and fixing defects in the software under test
Gaining confidence that the system is fit-for-purpose
Providing information for stakeholders' decision making
correctAnswer: Investigating and fixing defects in the software under test
explanation: refer 1.1.1 chọn B vì là của debug

questionText: Which of the following phases in the fundamental test process is considered to deliver a document which can be used as a major input for test process improvement?
options: Test planning and control
Test implementation & execution
Evaluating exit criteria and reporting
Test project closure
correctAnswer: Test project closure
explanation: refer 1.4.1 Giai đoạn nào sau đây trong quy trình kiểm thử cơ bản được coi là cung cấp một tài liệu có thể được sử dụng làm đầu vào chính để cải tiến quy trình kiểm thử? chọn D vì câu hỏi nhắc đến"test process improvement"

questionText: Which of the following would achieve the HIGHEST level of testing independence for a project's system test level?
options: Training developers to design good tests for the test team to execute.
Outsourcing test design and execution to a different company.
Having the company's independent test team design and execute the tests.
Minimising contact between testers and developers during test design to avoid bias.
correctAnswer: Outsourcing test design and execution to a different company.
explanation: refer 1.5.3 Điều nào sau đây sẽ đạt được mức độ độc lập kiểm tra CAO NHẤT đối với cấp độ kiểm tra hệ thống của dự án? chọn D vì "Outsourcing" là cao nhất

questionText: Which of the following is a valid drawback of independent testing?
options: Developer and independent testing will overlap and waste resources.
Developers loose the sense of responsibility and independent testers may become a bottleneck.
Independent testers need extra education and always cost more
Independent testers will become a bottleneck and introduce problems in incident management.
correctAnswer: Developers loose the sense of responsibility and independent testers may become a bottleneck.
explanation: refer 1.5.3 Điều nào sau đây là nhược điểm hợp lý của thử nghiệm độc lập? chọn B đúng sách

questionText: When considering the roles of test leader and tester, which of the following tasks would NOT typically be performed by a tester?
options: Prepare and acquire the test data
Set up and check the test environment
Write test summary reports
Review tests developed by others
correctAnswer: Write test summary reports
explanation: refer 1.4.5 nhiệm vụ nào sau đây thường KHÔNG được tester thực hiện? chọn C vì của Leader

questionText: Which list of levels of tester independence is in the correct order, starting with the most independent first?
options: Tests designed by the author; tests designed by another member of the development team; tests designed by someone from a different company
Tests designed by someone from a different department within the company; tests designed by the author; tests designed by someone from a different company.
Tests designed by someone from a different company; tests designed by someone from a different department within the company; tests designed by another member of the development team.
Tests designed by someone from a different department within the company; tests designed by someone from a different company; tests designed by the author.
correctAnswer: Tests designed by someone from a different company; tests designed by someone from a different department within the company; tests designed by another member of the development team.
explanation: refer 1.4.5. Danh sách các cấp độ độc lập của người thử nghiệm được sắp xếp theo đúng thứ tự, bắt đầu từ mức độ độc lập cao nhất trước tiên? chọn C

questionText: Hand over of Testware is a part of which Phase:
options: Test Analysis and Design
Test Planning and control
Test Closure Activities
Evaluating exit criteria and reporting
correctAnswer: Test Closure Activities
explanation: refer 1.4.1 "Hand over of Testware" của phase nào? xem sách chọn C

questionText: Reporting Discrepancies as incidents is a part of which phase:
options: Test Analysis and Design
Test Implementation and execution
Test Closure Activities
Evaluating exit criteria and reporting
correctAnswer: Test Implementation and execution
explanation: refer 1.4.1 Báo cáo sự khác biệt do sự cố là một phần của giai đoạn nào: "Discrepancies" xem sách thì là của execution test

questionText: What should be the MAIN objective during development testing?
options: To cause as many failures as possible so that defects in the software are identified and can be fixed
To confirm that the system works as expected and that requirements have been met
To assess the quality of the software with no intention of fixing defects
To give information to stakeholders of the risk of releasing the system at a given time
correctAnswer: To cause as many failures as possible so that defects in the software are identified and can be fixed
explanation: refer 1.1.1 Mục tiêu CHÍNH trong quá trình thử nghiệm phát triển là gì? chọn A tìm đc nhiều lỗi nhất có thể, B thì là mục tiêu của Acceptance test, C đánh giá chất lượng ko nằm trong mục tiêu của test, D là cung cấp thông tin cho các bên ở thời điểm Release ko phải Development test nên ko chọn D

questionText: Which of the following is not a part of the Test Implementation and Execution Phase?
options: Creating test suites from the test cases
Executing test cases either manually or by using test execution tools
Comparing actual results
Designing the Tests
correctAnswer: Designing the Tests
explanation: refer 1.4.1 Cái nào ko đúng thuộc giai đoạn Test Implementation and Execution? chọn D đúng, vì A của implementation, B C là của execution

questionText: Which of the following statements BEST describes one of the seven key principles of software testing?
options: Automated tests are better than manual tests for avoiding the Exhaustive Testing
Exhaustive testing is, with sufficient effort and tool support, feasible for all software
It is normally impossible to test all input / output combinations for a software system.
The purpose of testing is to demonstrate the absence of defects.
correctAnswer: It is normally impossible to test all input / output combinations for a software system.
explanation: refer 1.3 Câu nào sau đây mô tả TỐT NHẤT một trong bảy nguyên tắc chính của kiểm thử phần mềm? chọn C đúng nhất, Loại A vì so sánh này ko có căn cứ, Loại B vì "Exhaustive testing" test tất cả không thể xảy ra cho tất cả phần mềm, Loại D vì  "demonstrate the absence of defects" là sai vì Test ko thể chứng minh sự vắng mặt của lỗi

questionText: What is the benefit of independent testing?
options: More work gets done because testers do not disturb the developers all the time
Independent testers tend to be unbiased and find different defects than the developers
Independent testers do not need extra education and training
Independent testers reduce the bottleneck in the incident management process
correctAnswer: Independent testers tend to be unbiased and find different defects than the developers
explanation: refer 1.5.3 như sách rồi

questionText: Which is not a major task of test implementation and execution?
options: Develop and prioritizing test cases, creating test data, writing test procedures and optionally, preparing test harness and writing automated test scripts.
Logging the outcome of test execution and recording the identities and versions of the software under test, test tools and testware.
Checking test logs against the exit criteria specified in test planning.
Verifying that the test environment has been set up correctly.
correctAnswer: Checking test logs against the exit criteria specified in test planning.
explanation: refer 1.4.1 Chọn C vì của test monitoring and control

questionText: Which is not the testing objective?
options: Triggering failures
Gaining confidence about the level of quality and providing information
Evaluating test basis
Debugging defects
correctAnswer: Debugging defects
explanation: refer 1.1.1 và 1.1.2, Debug là hoạt động gỡ lỗi ko phải mục tiêu test

questionText: When assembling a test team to work on an enhancement to an existing system, which of the following has the highest level of test independence?
options: A business analyst who wrote the original requirements for the system.
A permanent programmer who reviewed some of the new code, but has not written any of it.
A permanent tester who found most defects in the original system.
A contract tester who has never worked for the organization before
correctAnswer: A contract tester who has never worked for the organization before
explanation: refer 1.5.3 điều nào sau đây có mức độ độc lập kiểm tra cao nhất? nhìn vào sơ đồ chọn D vì "A contract tester" là tester thuê bên ngoài

questionText:
The following statements relate to activities that are part of the fundamental test process. 
i. Evaluating the testability of requirements.
 ii. Repeating testing activities after changes.
 iii. Designing the test environment set-up. 
iv. Developing and prioritizing test cases.
v. Verifying the environment is set up correctly. 
Which statement below is TRUE?
options: (i) and (ii) are part of analysis and design, (iii), (iv) and (v) are part of test implementation and execution.
(i) and (iii) are part of analysis and design, (ii), (iv) and (v) are part of test implementation and execution.
(i) and (v) are part of analysis and design, (ii), (iii) and (iv) are part of test implementation and execution
(i) and (iv) are part of analysis and design, (ii), (iii) and (v) are part of test implementation and execution.
correctAnswer: (i) and (iii) are part of analysis and design, (ii), (iv) and (v) are part of test implementation and execution.
explanation: refer 1.4. Câu này rõ ràng là i là của test analysis, iii, iv là của test design còn lại là của implement và execution. Vì thế các bạn lăn tăn giữa đáp án B và D đều có khả năng đúng. Tuy nhiên Đúng nhất là B vì iii là design test environment ko thể để đến giai đoạn test implementation đc, còn iii. Design and priorityTC là hoạt động làm cả ở giai đoạn test design, đến test implement vẫn làm ( bạn nhớ là automation test cũng là Test case còn gọi là test case tự động)

questionText: Which of the following is an example of testing as part of the requirements specification phase?
options: A requirements review meeting
A business analyst eliciting requirements
Performing acceptance tests against requirements
A test report showing requirements coverage
correctAnswer: A requirements review meeting
explanation: refer 1.4.1. Điều nào sau đây là ví dụ về thử nghiệm như một phần của giai đoạn đặc tả yêu cầu? chọn A vì có review, loại B vì đây "eliciting requirements" là  task của BA, C là của "acceptance tests", D là "A test report showing requirements coverage" là sản phẩm của giai đoạn chạy test

questionText: Which of the following answers describes a test condition?
options: A testable aspect of a component or system identified as a basis for testing
A distinguishing characteristic of a component or system
The degree to which a software product provides functions which meet stated and implied needs when the software is used under specified conditions
test cases designed to execute combinations of conditions and actions resulting from them
correctAnswer: A testable aspect of a component or system identified as a basis for testing
explanation: Refer 1.4.1 hoặc tra glossary từ test condition

questionText: Which one of the following is the BEST description of a test condition?
options: An attribute of a component or system specified or implied by requirements documentation.
An aspect of the test basis that is relevant to achieve specific test objectives.
The capability of the software product to provide functions which meet stated and implied needs when the software is used under specified conditions.
The percentage of all single condition outcomes that independently affect a decision outcome that have been exercised by a test case suite.
correctAnswer: An aspect of the test basis that is relevant to achieve specific test objectives.
explanation: Refer 1.4. hoặc refer lên glossary để tra định nghĩa của test condition bạn thấy nó là 1 "aspect of test basis"

questionText: Which one of the statements below describes a defect discovered during testing ?
options: The product crashed when the user selected an option in a dialog box.
The developer of the system forgot to rename variables after a cut-and-paste operation
The developer misinterpreted the requirement for the algorithm.
The computation algorithm used the wrong input variables.
correctAnswer: The computation algorithm used the wrong input variables.
explanation: Refer 1.2.3. Mô tả nào về defect là đúng. ở đây thì A là failure rồi, B C là Error chỉ còn D là defect

questionText: Which of the following is an example of a defect in a car cruise control system?
options: The developer of the system forgot to rename variables after a cut-and-paste operation.
Unnecessary code that sounds an alarm when reversing was included in the system.
The system stops maintaining a set speed when the radio volume is increased or decreased.
The design specification for the system wrongly states speeds in km/h.
correctAnswer: The design specification for the system wrongly states speeds in km/h.
explanation: Refer 1.2.3. chọn D là lỗi sai trong tài liệu Design. ( nếu câu này đc chọn 2 đáp án thì chọn B, D, nhưng nếu chỉ đc chọn 1 thì D là đúng nhất vì wrongly của D là sai hơn Unnecessary của B)

questionText:
A phone ringing in a neighboring cubicle distracts a programmer causing him to improperly program the logic that checks the upper boundary of an input variable. Later, during system testing, a tester notices that this input field accepts invalid input values.
Which of the following correctly describes an incorrectly coded upper bound?
options: The root cause
A failure
An error
A defect
correctAnswer: A defect
explanation: Refer 1.2.3 chú ý vào câu hỏi đang hỏi từ nào mô tả về cái incorrectly code
